verdict.rationale: DBOS's docs directly target this story. Agents built with the OpenAI Agents SDK or Vercel AI become durable workflows with drop-in runners or a few annotations (dbos-docs-15, dbos-docs-30, dbos-docs-40). Each step is checkpointed to Postgres, so a crash mid-agent replays completed steps and resumes from the last completed one (dbos-docs-38, dbos-docs-36, dbos-docs-4, dbos-docs-11); the co-founder's HN explanation of per-step output logging supports this (dbos-comm-13). missing for 10: explicit documentation of per-step retry policies for model and tool calls, independent hands-on corroboration of crash recovery specifically for agent loops.
